name: Avni Bhardwaj
bio: B.Tech Computer Engineering at NMIMS Indore (2022-2026), CGPA 3.37/4.0.
Based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Works across data engineering, cloud, AI/ML, backend software, and embedded systems.
Open to collaborations, internships, and product-focused projects.

education.institution: Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies (NMIMS), Indore

work: Architected FP-BOT, a Dockerized retrieval-augmented generation pipeline using LlamaIndex, vLLM, and Qdrant to index documentation from 30+ tools, deployed through Jenkins CI/CD and queried through FastAPI.

Built AirSimuPy, a Python and PySide6 simulation platform using NetworkX and NumPy to execute block-diagram data pipelines with a Hybrid Compiled Architecture, reducing team reliance on MATLAB Simulink.
Validated a Python-based Sorting Tool against legacy Fortran solvers.

projects.name: Autonomous AI Research Agent (Briefing-Bot)
projects.description: Uses Pydantic AI and Gemini to filter 100+ daily articles from 5+ feeds into high-signal digests; the portfolio describes 5+ hours saved per week, GitHub Actions scheduling, zero infrastructure cost, and a Pydantic-schema backend.

projects.name: Personalized AI Financial Advisor
projects.description: Uses 70k+ Finance-Alpaca/FiQA records, a fine-tuned Llama-3 8B model with Unsloth/PyTorch, LangChain ReAct agentic RAG with live yfinance data, and a Streamlit UI.

projects.name: MapMyNotes
projects.description: Turns notes, PDFs, and slides into interactive D3.js mind maps with Gemini explanations, flashcards, and quizzes.

projects.name: Job Hunt Automation
projects.description: Reads public Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby ATS APIs, prefilters postings, scores resumes with an LLM, drafts application kits, and sends a daily email digest.

projects.name: Weather MCP Server
projects.description: Normalizes OpenWeatherMap responses, uses TTL/Redis caching, and includes Jest tests and a demo UI.

projects.name: Fake News Detection
projects.description: Uses TF-IDF and cosine similarity, with 89% accuracy and a Streamlit app.

projects.name: Deep Learning Research
projects.description: Confidential image-classification/diagnostics research under review for publication, using an ensemble of DenseNet201, SE-ResNet50, MobileNetV3-Large-100, and Xception.

projects.name: IoT Actuator Control
projects.description: Arduino Uno and ESP8266 actuator-control project.
